s1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By creating an account on Ideora you accept these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any of them, you must not use the service.

s2.title: 2. Accounts
s2.body: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for everything that happens under your account. Registration data must be accurate and up to date. One account per person: identity impersonation and mass automated accounts are not allowed.

s3.title: 3. Published content
s3.body: You are solely responsible for the content you publish. By publishing it you grant Ideora a limited license to operate the service (store, display and distribute it on the platform), without affecting your rights to the content. Publishing illegal, offensive or third-party-infringing content is prohibited.

s4.title: 4. Conduct
s4.body: You must use the platform respectfully and without abuse: no harassment, spam, scams or attempts to bypass security or moderation measures. Repeated violations may lead to the suspension of your account.

s5.title: 5. Moderation
s5.body: Ideora may review, moderate, archive or remove content that violates these terms or the law, and may suspend accounts that breach them. You can report content through the report buttons on the site.

s6.title: 6. Term and termination
s6.body: These terms apply while you use the service. You may stop using it at any time and delete your account or your content. Ideora may suspend or close your account if you breach this agreement.

s7.title: 7. Applicable law
s7.body: These terms are governed by Spanish and European law (including the General Data Protection Regulation). For any questions you can contact us through the official project repository.

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.body: The data controller is Ideora, an independent, community-run platform. You can contact us through the official project repository.

s2.title: 2. Data we collect
s2.body: We collect the data you provide when creating your account (name and email), the data you add to your profile (description, sector, skills, avatar) and the content you publish (projects, videos, services, comments). Additionally, for security and operational reasons we record technical data such as your IP address, browser type and activity logs.

s3.title: 3. Purposes
s3.body: We use your data to provide the service (auth, publishing and searching content), to protect the platform and its users (usage limits, blocks, reports and moderation) and to improve the website. We do not use your data for personalized advertising.

s4.title: 4. Legal basis
s4.body: We process your data based on the performance of the service contract, our legal obligations and our legitimate interest in the security and proper functioning of the platform. Consent is recorded by accepting these terms at sign-up.

s5.title: 5. Sharing data
s5.body: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We only share the essential data with our processors (hosting and database providers, such as Supabase and the deployment provider) to operate the service. Content you publish publicly is visible to other users according to the scope you choose.

s6.title: 6. Retention
s6.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account or your content, the associated data is removed within a reasonable time, except where the law requires us to keep it.

s7.title: 7. Your rights
s7.body: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to data portability, to restrict processing and to withdraw consent. You can exercise them from your profile settings or by contacting us. You can also request complete deletion of your account.

s8.title: 8. Contact
s8.body: For any privacy question, contact us through the official project repository.
